guide.intro: Scheduled tasks of the CC Desk Tunnel client. When a task is due, the client sends its session a message tagged “Scheduled task”, with the prompt as its text.
guide.reload: Changes to this file apply within seconds, without a restart; a task that does not fit the format does not run, and the client’s Scheduled tasks panel says why.
guide.fields: Task fields: id (any string no other task uses), name, enabled (true/false), prompt (at most 15000 characters), schedule, target, model, effort.
guide.schedule: schedule is one of these, all in this computer’s local time: {"type":"once","at":"2026-01-31T09:00"}, {"type":"daily","time":"09:00"},
guide.target: target is one of: {"type":"session","sessionId":"…"} continues an existing session; {"type":"new","projectPath":"D:\\Projects"} opens a new session each time.
guide.model: model and effort may be null (the session keeps its current setting); effort is low / medium / high / xhigh / max.
guide.when: Tasks run only while the client is running and connected; a run that still cannot be sent 10 minutes after its time is skipped. For unattended runs the session should approve automatically, or it stops at the approval.

problem.duplicateId: id is used by another task
problem.text: {{field}} should be non-empty text of at most {{max}} characters
problem.at: schedule.at should be a time like 2026-01-31T09:00
problem.days: schedule.days should be an array of 1 to 7
problem.minutes: schedule.minutes should be a whole number of at least 5
problem.type: schedule.type should be once / daily / weekly / interval
problem.effort: effort should be low / medium / high / xhigh / max or null
problem.model: model should be a model name or null

outcome.blocked: can’t send now: not connected, or the session is running

form.name: Name
form.notAuto: This session doesn’t approve automatically: unattended, the task stops at an approval until someone answers it.
form.bypass: This session bypasses permissions: unattended, the task does anything without asking.

intro.title: Schedule a task
intro.text: When a task is due, the client on this computer sends its session a message tagged “Scheduled task”, so Claude Code takes care of recurring work for you.
intro.when: Tasks run only while the client is running and connected; a run still not sent 10 minutes after its time is skipped.
intro.approval: For unattended runs, let the target session approve automatically, or it stops at the approval.
intro.policy: Tasks are sent by the program on its own. With a subscription sign-in, the limits are set for ordinary personal use; see <link>the official usage policy</link> to judge whether automatic sending suits it.
intro.file: The file {{path}} can be edited directly, or Claude can set it up for you; changes apply within seconds.
